title: Sign or reuse the aesthetic consent
summary: Choose today's services, check the photo authorizations and sign, or use an earlier signature.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Aesthetic session
steps.details: Opens the guided flow of a new session. Nothing is saved until you choose a service.

steps.title: Status and progress
steps.details: The status comes from the data: Draft, Consented, In treatment, Ready to close. Each finished step adds 25%. Next to it you see what is missing and when it was saved: everything saves on its own.

steps.title: Date and doctor
steps.details: Session date (it can't be in the future) and who performs it. From My Workspace they come from the appointment.

steps.title: Today's services
steps.details: Check what is being done today. Only aesthetic services appear; if one is missing, set it up in Sales → Services. "Last session" adds those from the previous time.

steps.title: Reuse a signature
steps.details: If the patient already signed this service, you can use that signature instead of asking again. It never changes an authorization already given in this session.

steps.title: Consent text
steps.details: The one for the service, with the patient details filled in; "View text" shows another service's. If the service has no template of its own, the generic text is used. What was signed is stored as is, with its SHA-256 fingerprint.

steps.title: Risks explained
steps.details: Required. Authorizations are checked once for all pending consents.

steps.title: Photos for the clinical record
steps.details: Without this authorization the camera stays locked and the session can be closed without photos.

steps.title: Marketing photos
steps.details: Optional: allows using them for promotion.

steps.title: Who signs
steps.details: The patient by default; change it if a guardian signs.

steps.title: Signature
steps.details: Sign with your finger, a stylus or the mouse.

steps.title: Sign
steps.details: Signs all pending services at once. What was signed can no longer be changed.

steps.title: Continue to photos
steps.details: Enabled once every service is signed. If some are still unsigned, "Mark the signed ones" goes straight to the treatment of those already signed.
